significance.justification: If verified true, the conclusion would be a form-(iii) predictive coupling, with a form-(ii) causal consequence: the "eventual winning branch is linearly decodable at the branch point," and suppressing predicted losing branches preserves the answer while reducing generated tokens. It establishes both a behavioral phenomenon—apparently serial exploration is partly precommitted—and a mechanism—ranked alternatives coexist in the residual stream—and predicts that branch-point states will forecast later commitments across many branch events; this bears directly on latent-deliberation accounts such as Coconut (Hao et al., 2024) and thinking-before-speaking approaches such as Quiet-STaR (Zelikman et al., 2024). A verified-false result would rule out linearly accessible precommitment as an explanation and undermine pruning based on that signal, although it would not rule out nonlinear or later-emerging representations, so the two branches are distinguishable but asymmetrically informative. In the topic-substitution check, efficient mechanistic reasoning alone would not earn this score: the specific precommitment-to-later-choice relation and its causal token-efficiency consequence are substantially sharper than the median proposal.

reach.justification: The named handles are "linear probes on residual-stream states at branch points" and a "branch-pruning controller" that blocks a continuation predicted to be losing. This is ex ante at the branch point—before the losing branch's tokens are generated—so it provides an action window for inference-time gating rather than merely explaining waste after it occurs. The hypothesis is framed across "reasoning models" and several classes of reasoning tasks, and after per-model re-extraction it predicts the same measurable coupling between branch-point state and eventual commitment; downstream users could therefore include inference-system builders and deployment practitioners seeking accuracy-token trade-offs, not only interpretability researchers. The topic-substitution check does not preserve this score: generic efficient-reasoning work supplies no comparable early-warning signal, whereas this claim supplies a forecast and intervention target that can be used before the waste occurs.
